description: This PHP source file manages option transfer functionality, including configuration and setup of double select box UI components, such as enabling transfer buttons, setting styles, and initializing option maps for 'from' and 'to' select boxes.

methods.name: opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Configures the option transfer (double select box) by setting JavaScript event handlers and updating the maps of 'from' and 'to' options based on the provided right list.

methods.name: keywords_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Initializes and configures the option transfer UI components, including size, style, event handlers, and the setup of 'from' and 'to' select boxes, then calls opt_transf_cfg to finalize configuration.

methods.name: opt_transf_empty_cfg
methods.description: Creates an empty default configuration object for option transfer, initializing all necessary fields with default values.

methods.name: item_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Similar to keywords_opt_transf_cfg, configures option transfer UI components, but for a different context or data set, then calls opt_transf_cfg.
